title: Settle detail reads by default before passing page time to a check

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — Caught

Story: SEED-344#settle-reads-before-passing-page-time, checked at 254a06c8cbf03bbf3e364315226f1fda7de46b5c (implementation 7da9700a3a07b653062bfc1a3bb4366eefbc7fb5). The selected promise is that the ordinary next-check helper settles outstanding page reads before advancing page time, preserving the next check's steady pace.

One plausible fault was introduced only in an isolated scratch worktree: remove `await untilPageReadsAnswered(page)` from `passTimeUntilChecked` in `dashboard/tests/autoRefreshJourney.ts`. Fixtures and maintained assertions were unchanged.

Maintained check: `dashboard/tests/stories/direction-disclosure.spec.ts`, “same-project refresh retains expanded and collapsed choices through loading, replacement, and failure”. Its published A/B fixture holds B's backlog read, starts another default check, then releases B and observes its next check through `expectSteadyPace(await nextCheck)`.

The same focused command ran three times:

`caffeinate -s -i npm run --silent test:dashboard -- dashboard/tests/stories/direction-disclosure.spec.ts --grep 'same-project refresh retains expanded and collapsed choices through loading, replacement, and failure'`

Each run used a distinct `OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_PROOF_RECORD` destination. Baseline: one selected case passed, strict exit 0. Faulted: that case failed, strict exit 1. Restored: the same case passed, strict exit 0. The assertion that caught the fault was `expectSteadyPace`'s upper bound in `autoRefreshJourney.ts`: expected at most 15,250 ms; observed 28,250 ms.

Independent wrong-behavior observation came from the retained faulted browser trace. B's read occupied trace monotonic time 3850.429–3879.316 ms. The next-check helper completed a 250 ms `clockRunFor` step at 3869.301 ms, before the no-problem assertion finished at 3869.598 ms; the maintained journey releases B only after that assertion. Page time therefore advanced while B was still held. The earlier immediate `Date.now() === heldAt` sample passed before this step; the subsequent steady-pace assertion caught the resulting wrong behavior. This check establishes protection for this exercised held-B/next-check path. It does not claim that the faulted run reproduced a detail-recovery timeout or that every pending-read shape was checked.

Restoration and cleanup: a finally/signal restoration guard restored the helper's exact original bytes. The scratch Git status matched its initially clean pre-probe state, `git diff --exit-code` passed, and the same focused check passed after restoration. The clean detached scratch worktree was removed. The primary execution checkout was not edited.

Evidence retained outside checkout cleanup: `/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-344.7SMN5j/` contains `baseline.json`, `faulted.json`, `restored.json`, `fault.patch`, `faulted-output.txt`, `faulted-trace.zip`, `wrong-behavior-evidence.json`, and the original helper bytes. All three records are completed and identify exactly one selected case.

Next proof action: retain the existing steady-pace assertion and held-B journey as protection for this default; no new proof repair is supported by this single check. The safe default and strengthened journey were already implemented before this probe. No new repair or follow-up decision was made here.

Cost:

- Test runtime — measured from the runner's terminal proof records: baseline 9.041 s, faulted 4.093 s, restored 4.341 s; total 17.475 s. Setup used a fresh locked `npm ci`; these runner figures include each run's own setup.
- Human effort — unavailable; no developer-operated observation was requested, and no human-effort counter was exposed.
- Agent effort — unavailable; no separately supported token or active-work counter was exposed. Invocation elapsed is reported separately below.
- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 190111 ms (measured), from 1794566548198 to 1794566738309 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision: 254a06c8cbf03bbf3e364315226f1fda7de46b5c. The only subsequent maintained edit documents the existing helper rule in dashboard/tests/writing-journeys.md; the checked helper, journey, fixture and assertion remain unchanged. Retain the maintained held-B/steady-pace observation. The scratch fault was caught and restored, with no evidence of an actual delivered defect or actionable coverage gap. No new correction or queue change is justified; no matching follow-up requires disposition. This one probe protects only its exercised path, not the entire story. Evidence remains in /private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-344.7SMN5j/.
